name: free-token-cloud
description: A free, self-hosted token cloud composed of a routing core and a login-capable provider hub.

relay-core.role: OpenAI, Anthropic and Responses compatible routing, tool bridging, cooldowns and metrics

provider-setup.role: Self-owned login links, API-key entry, validation and activation guidance

edge.role: Authenticated public entry, body limits, rate limits and stream-safe proxying

control.role: No third-party runtime or local relay; clients use the relay API directly

automation.providerActivation: Encrypted credential save triggers config reload and provider activation
